title: Class relation linear algebra
objective: Implement sparse relation storage, modular rank/pivot screening, exact HNF/SNF presentation extraction and replay, with differential FLINT tests

handoff.summary: Added a standalone sparse relation accumulator with multi-prime incremental pivot screening, unlucky-prime replay, exact FLINT HNF/SNF extraction, ordinary-Python transform fallback, replayable class-map generator transforms, and left-kernel unit transforms. A production deferred-presentation policy now signals the first modular-full-rank extraction, batches later admitted relations, supports forced finalization and HNF-to-SNF upgrades, and authenticates serialized policy state against the last exact relation prefix. Frozen Sage 10.9 elementary-divisor fixtures and native-on/native-off differential, corruption, serialization, map, unit-kernel, collision, deferred-extraction, and benchmark tests pass.
risks: Rows are relation exponent vectors in factor-base order and act on the right: H = H_left*A and S = S_left*A*S_right. Consumers using column vectors must transpose explicitly.
Exact transforms are intentionally dense once extraction is requested; relation collection should retain the sparse accumulator and defer presentation extraction until modular full rank is reached.

Deferred policy replay uses a deterministic two-word prefix fingerprint as a scheduling-state binding, not as a mathematical certificate; context checkpoint authentication and exact RelationPresentation.verify remain the certificate boundaries.
The coordinator requested focused handoff validation; broad test:native and test:changed gates remain for central integration and four-platform CI.
next_steps: Have class_unit_engine query DeferredPresentationPolicy.extract_if_due after each admitted relation, retain the last non-None presentation separately, and call force=True only at a consumer/finalization boundary.
Wire RelationMatrixAccumulator.to_dict plus DeferredPresentationPolicy.to_dict as shared context matrix state and RelationPresentation.generator_transforms/class_coordinates into the maps lane.
Run central broad native, changed-file, and four-platform validation after integrating sibling class/unit lanes.
